    48	A Stirling permutation of order $n$ is a word in which every label in
    49	$[n]=\{1,\ldots,n\}$ occurs twice and all entries strictly between the two
    50	occurrences of $j$ exceed $j$. Write $\Q_n$ for this set, with
    51	$\Q_0=\{\varnothing\}$. For $n\ge1$, factor a word uniquely as $w=A1B1C$
    52	and define
    53	\begin{equation}\label{eq:map}
    54	 T_n(A1B1C)=\dec(A)\,nn\,\dec(B)\dec(C),
    55	 \qquad \dec(j)=j-1\quad(j>1).
    56	\end{equation}
    57	The empty word is fixed. The insertion slot in \eqref{eq:map} is the old
    58	first occurrence of one, not an arbitrary gap.
